consumer: The pickup path's weight-eligibility gate calling Character::can_pick_weight(item), asking 'with this item added does carried weight stay within (the safe/unsafe) capacity bound — may the avatar pick it up?'
scope: only the character's own carried load plus the single candidate item (weight_carried() + it.weight() vs weight_capacity()), not reachable-nearby inventory
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::can_pick_weight — returns weight_carried()+weight <= weight_capacity()*4 on the unsafe pickup branch, or <= weight_capacity() on the safe branch (DEBUG_STORAGE short-circuits to mass_max); this is the engine-computed yes/no the pickup path consumes, with weight_capacity() only an input it derives from
divergence: Avatar carrying just under weight_capacity(); the candidate item pushes weight_carried()+weight above weight_capacity() but below weight_capacity()*4: the real unsafe pickup predicate (safe=false) returns true, while a re-derivation comparing only against weight_capacity() returns false — the wrong authority blocks a pickup the engine would allow
